# WASI limits: the goldens that cannot run on a WASI target, because the
# platform lacks what they use (sockets in preview 1, processes, file modes
# and locks, a working directory, C calls). None is a gap in the wasm
# backend: a golden that fails for wasm for any other reason is fixed, not
# listed (audit of 2026-11-05: every line below fails on its targets only).
#
# A line: NAME # TARGETS # AREA: REASON. TARGETS is `wasip1` (preview 1
# lacks it, the wasip2 component runs it) or `wasip1 wasip2`; AREA is one of
# network, processes, files, c.
#
# TestSelfhostWasm (wasip1/wasm, Node) and TestWasmCommandGoldens
# (wasip2/wasm components, wasmtime, decision 0447 stage 3) each expect to
# fail exactly the lines naming their target: a golden failing there
# unlisted, or listed there and passing (a full run), fails the test, so a
# regression such as 0.34.0's (Chan programs refused for wasm for twelve
# days) cannot hide among the limits. One list for both tests since
# 2026-11-05 (gotchas/wasm-two-unsupported-lists.md); the file keeps its
# name because pushq and repotest read it.

cmd_inherit # wasip1 wasip2 # processes: XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.exec)
conn_deadline # wasip1 # network: the network (`rt.net_listen`): WASI preview1 has no sockets
conn_iface # wasip1 # network: the network (`rt.net_listen`): WASI preview1 has no sockets
dns_no_tasks # wasip1 # network: the call `rt.call_c2` (std/dns's native resolver)
dns_records # wasip1 # network: the network (`rt.net_listen`): WASI preview1 has no sockets
fs_atomic # wasip1 wasip2 # files: WASI has no file modes or locks: write_atomic's mode
fs_cwd_path # wasip1 wasip2 # files: no working directory under WASI
fs_dir_errors # wasip1 wasip2 # files: WASI has no file modes or locks
fs_files # wasip1 wasip2 # files: WASI has no file modes or locks
fs_mkdir_mode # wasip1 wasip2 # files: WASI has no file modes or locks: create_dir_all_mode
fs_ops_edges # wasip1 wasip2 # files: WASI has no times before 1970
